graph.sourceBoundaryDefinition: complete four-neighbour <=2.0 ft components of at least one acre that touch the exterior DEM boundary or intersect a supplied tidal component marker
graph.manualSourceTreatment: component markers only; polygons never paint source geometry and sub-acre components are rejected
graph.bulkheadTerrainTreatment: stitched into input DEM with GDAL before graph construction
graph.stormDrains: disabled; not connectivity seeds and no exchange flow
graph.controlVolumeConnectivity: four-neighbour components within each tile/connection bin; hard structures and fixed-head sources isolated as separate material classes

render.fixedHeadBoundaryDisplay: the complete qualified source is visible at 2.0 ft and all twenty-five underlying one-foot cells are area aggregated; fractional edge coverage is encoded without center-cell aliasing
